title: Competition assay, negative: under birth-site depletion the faster heritable Marangoni kind (mar 60) loses to mar 40 against its neutral-label twin (seed 610: share 0.75 -> 0.40 vs twin 0.75-0.86), although its dividing rods swim farther per cycle (6/9 pass the M gate vs 1/5); on seed 611 mar 60 is lost early in both arms
summary: Loop 1's depletion world with founders of two self-copied kinds (mar 40 and mar 60, random 16 px blocks of initial surfactant) and mutation off, on fresh seeds 610-611, with each environment's identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) and the sink-disc world without depletion. Selection on mar 60 (ladder share minus twin label share, t >= 1000 / end): depletion -0.35/-0.35 and 0/0; sink discs only -0.15/-0.34 and +0.21/+0.15. Mar-60 dividing rods do pass the M gate more under depletion (6/9 vs 1/5, median D 3.57 vs 2.12), but mar-60 bodies dissolve more per split (15 per 13 vs 5 per 7). Distance pays the individual in this environment, but the heritable trait that buys distance is not favoured.

finding.operator: birth-site depletion discs (trait-blind) with two self-copied Marangoni kinds in competition
finding.control: identical-event twin per environment (MARS 40/40/40, neutral label), sink-disc world without depletion; paired seeds 610-611
finding.result: mar-60 share t>=1000 / end, ladder vs twin: depletion 0.51/0.40 vs 0.86/0.75 (610), 0/0 vs 0/0 (611); sink discs 0.66/0.46 vs 0.81/0.80 (610), 0.21/0.15 vs 0/0 (611). M pass under depletion seed 610: k2 6/9, k1 1/5.
